# Brief: RepairLog

## Product
A repair log for small bike shops: each bike's jobs, parts and a pickup status board for the counter in one place; no bike owner data is stored.

## Audience & initial segment
Independent bike repair shops in Poland with 1–3 mechanics.

## Problem
Shops lose track of which bike is waiting for which part, and customers call to ask when it is ready.

## Alternatives & advantage
Paper notebooks, phone photos and WhatsApp messages; generic workshop software built for car garages.

## Revenue model
Subscription per shop.

## Customer language
- "Half my day is answering 'is my bike ready?' calls." — shop owner, interview 2026-08-21
- "The notebook is fine until a page gets oil on it." — mechanic, interview 2026-08-23
